subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction drop aborted assistant tool-call turns before summarization, matching the prompt-send/replay sanitizer policy, or require a different missing-result policy?
rationale: The code path and proof support the fix, but the remaining choice is a session-state product policy tradeoff between small context loss and synthesized model-visible recovery data.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge after normal exact-head checks, accepting that aborted tool-call turns are omitted from compaction summaries to avoid strict-provider rejection.

options.title: Require synthetic recovery
options.body: Ask the author to preserve interrupted turn context with a synthetic result or richer marker before merge, with tests for provider acceptance and model-facing behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge after normal exact-head checks, accepting that aborted tool-call turns are omitted from compaction summaries to avoid strict-provider rejection.
